name: gitEnglish Hub
prompt_hint: Use a dark theme with background #262424, card backgrounds #383535, accent color #ff6600 (burnt orange), text color #e0ded2, border color #555252. Body uses a system-ui font stack (pre-installed on all devices — do NOT load or import any font for body text). Headings use 'Raleway' (bold/black weights), which is provided via an embedded @font-face already present in the document. IMPORTANT: Cards must be FLAT and EDITORIAL — NO neumorphic shadows, NO dual-direction box-shadows, NO soft 3D depth effects. Define cards using thin borders (1px solid #555252) and flat tonal contrast between background and card fill. Use border-radius of 8px max — sharp, structured edges. Use the accent color #ff6600 structurally: thin left-border accent bars on cards (3-4px), full-width divider lines under section headers (2-3px), and heading text color. Keep shadows minimal or none — the look is flat, high-contrast, and editorial (think dark-mode IDE meets print magazine, not soft tactile UI). ACCENT GRADIENT: Use a subtle, classy gradient from burnt orange (#ff6600) to burnt rose (#cc4466) on key accent elements — title slides, section header dividers, button hovers, and highlight text. Apply it tastefully and sparingly (e.g. background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6600, #cc4466) on the main accent bar or hero text). It should feel premium and a little bold, not flashy. Include the gitEnglish logo image in a footer or corner. All CSS must be inline in a single <style> tag — no external CDN links, no Tailwind CDN, no <script> tags, and NO @import or <link> for fonts (the document must render fully offline as a standalone file).
print_css: @media print { body { background: #fff !important; color: #333 !important; } .ge-card { background: #f5f5f5 !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: 1px solid #ddd !important; } .ge-accent { color: #cc5500 !important; } button[id='regenerate'] { display: none !important; } @page { margin: 1.5cm; size: A4; } }
